tasks.title: Zoned shells place no floors in the roof space
tasks.notes: From sherlock, 2026-10-29. Covers Floors built inside the roof space (I-037, snag S-061, southampton-build). Cause: shell_zoned (lib/builds/feature_build.py, column loop 'for y in range(g + 1, ry)') places a storey floor at every (y - datum) % STOREY_H == 0 up to each column's roof level with no eave check; for pitched zones the roof level is eave plus ridge rise, so floors land in the roof space. DELIVERABLE: store the per-column eave (same metres_aod_to_y value as the zone loop) as f.zone_eave and place a storey floor only where y < eave (strict); unzoned shell and flat zones unchanged; unit tests beside the pitched-zone tests in lib/builds/test_feature_build.py (no floor above eave, lower storeys keep floors, flat zone unchanged). CHECK S-061: dry run of west_w34391673 (python3 scripts/feature_build.py --world southampton-build worlds/southampton-build/site/builds/west_w34391673.json) counts 0 floor blocks above the eave; in game West has no slab floor inside or showing through the roof. Not verified: which block S-061's visible slabs are (floor material or roof membrane). Blocked by #204 (same file). Log the fix on I-037 with issues.py fix.
